label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: [name] banner had no direct decline button; I had to open [name] settings, switch off three categories one by one, then press Agree and continue.
The product link name repeats the title and price several times and includes colour image names, so it is very long; one card in a hidden carousel slide could not be clicked and timed out.

element.name: The T-Shirt The T-Shirt 50 EUR The T-Shirt-Black The T-Shirt-Grey Melange The T-Shirt-White White The T-Shirt

findings.problem: After Add to cart the dialog stayed open with a nameless disabled button and no message that the item was added; only the cart count changed to 1 after a re-read.
Several controls have no accessible name: the nameless disabled button, the colour variants link, and the homepage carousel links.

On first load the shipping area was an empty iframe and payment showed a raw error text about a missing snippet; the real form only appeared after waiting. The email and postal code form said the address must be in [name], which clashes with the US address I was given.
